column3: MT 4:14. Close to the Hebrew; “you will gash yourself” (the verb can also mean “gather in troops”) is rendered “gather yourself in troops.”

MT 5:1. NKJV renders “insignificant to be among the clans of Judah” as “Though you are little among the thousands of Judah,” “his origins” as “Whose goings forth,” and “from days of antiquity” as “From everlasting.”
MT 5:2. Close to the Hebrew; “will return with the people of Israel” is rendered “Shall return to the children of Israel.”
MT 5:3. Close to the Hebrew; “he will shepherd” is rendered “feed His flock.”
MT 5:4. Close to the Hebrew; “our fortresses” is rendered “our palaces,” and “princes of men” “princely men.”
MT 5:5. Close to the Hebrew; “they will shepherd the land of Assyria with the sword” is rendered “They shall waste with the sword,” and NKJV supplies “us” after “deliver.”
MT 5:7. Close to the Hebrew; “the nations” is rendered “the Gentiles.”
MT 5:8. Close to the Hebrew; the wish “may your hand be lifted” is rendered as a statement, “Your hand shall be lifted.”
MT 5:13. Close to the Hebrew; “your Asherah poles” is rendered “your wooden images.”
MT 5:14. Close to the Hebrew; “which have not obeyed” is rendered “that have not heard.”
